from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyStockInfo(BaseModel):
    """Stock information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company_full_name: str | None = Field(description="The full company name as stated in the document")
    stock_short_name: str | None = Field(description="The stock short name/简称 as listed in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock code/证券代码 as listed in the document")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period of the financial report")
    document_order: int | None = Field(description="The sequence order of this document in the collection")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_stock_infos: list[CompanyStockInfo]
